infrastructure.ransomware_payload: ransom.exe (7,287,357 bytes), packaged as ransom.zip (7,121,752 bytes)

key_disagreements_between_sources.DE_position: Yes - based on Discord chat statement '랜섬웨어로 ... 만들긴 했거든요'
key_disagreements_between_sources.Team1st_position: No - Visual Studio and Sublime Text artifact analysis found ZERO ransomware source code; all editor activity was on cryptocurrency trading scripts (bitcoin.py, binance.py, etc.). Suspect likely received ransomware externally via USB.
key_disagreements_between_sources.ES_verification: ES confirms: SanDisk USB connected 2023-09-21 14:50:15 KST. ransom.zip created 14:50:49 KST (34 second gap). No editor activity tied to ransomware creation.
key_disagreements_between_sources.conclusion: Team1st position is forensically stronger. Suspect's Discord claim was deception or simplification. Real source: external (USB).

key_disagreements_between_sources.topic: When was the email from BM Company received?
key_disagreements_between_sources.ES_verification: OST file content not parsed by our 13 parsers - cannot verify directly. Both are within Sep 19.
key_disagreements_between_sources.conclusion: Use 1st place team timestamp (07:04) as it's more detailed and cross-checked.

key_disagreements_between_sources.topic: Was the ransom.exe executed on suspect's PC?
key_disagreements_between_sources.Team1st_position: Not explicitly addressed; team executed in VM for analysis
key_disagreements_between_sources.ES_verification: DEFINITIVE NO: No Prefetch record, no Amcache record, no UserAssist entry for ransom.exe. Shimcache/AppCompatCache only confirm file existence, not execution.
key_disagreements_between_sources.conclusion: ransom.exe was NOT executed on suspect's PC. This is consistent with operational design - suspect distributed for accomplice to spread, would not infect own machine.

events.event: ransom.zip materializes in C:\Users\souldrag\Pictures\ransom\ (7,121,752 bytes) - 34 seconds AFTER SanDisk USB connection
ransom.exe (7,287,357 bytes) inside ransom.zip - SHA1: 0b88dd8519259f4afd15aeb376ccea9c27b2a253
RETROACTIVE: ransom.exe path recorded in OpenSavePidlMRU registry (date predates MFT creation; suggests user interacted with filename earlier OR registry-vs-MFT timestamp disambiguation needed)
events.notes: Critical anomaly: Registry timestamp is BEFORE MFT creation. Either: (a) earlier ransom.exe version existed; (b) Registry value_data path was recorded retroactively; (c) timestamp interpretation discrepancy

events.event: Bandizip executed loading ransom.zip and ransom.exe as input files (final packaging step)
NEGATIVE FINDING: ransom.exe NEVER executed on suspect's PC. No Prefetch entry. No Amcache record. No UserAssist entry.
events.notes: Operational design: suspect distributes without executing on own machine. Consistent with rational threat actor.

events.event: NEGATIVE FINDING: NO ransomware source code in Visual Studio Code or Sublime Text 3 history. Only cryptocurrency trading scripts (binance.py, bitcoin.py, pyupbittest.py and 7 others).
